title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS as a historical battle-royale digital holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and KRAFTON online services.
preservation.concerns: Free-to-play live multiplayer titles face elevated preservation risk: server dependency, economy changes, and possible retirement of online services. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Left Early Access for full Steam release on December 21, 2017. Later free-to-play conversion revised distribution terms in place; this accession records the licensed digital edition in custody under the current storefront title.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and the required online services continue.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
